name: invoice_letter
document_label: Mexican invoice letter from an auto financier (carta factura)

fields.financier: financial institution that issues the letter
fields.contract_number: credit / contract number (número de contrato o crédito)
fields.letter_date: date of the letter, as printed
fields.amount: amount stated in the letter (valor / monto), if any
fields.version: line / type / version of the vehicle as printed
fields.invoice_number: number of the invoice the letter refers to
fields.validity: validity of the letter (vigencia) exactly as printed

vin.description: 17 caracteres alfanuméricos, sin I, O ni Q

extra_instructions: The letter is issued by the financier while the invoice is held as guarantee of the credit; it lets the customer drive the car. letter_date is the date the letter was signed, as printed. Copy the VIN character by character from the alphanumeric value, not the spelled-out one. Return money amounts as numbers with decimals, no currency symbols or commas. If the letter prints a validity (vigencia), copy it as printed; never compute an end date.
